title: Essence Crafting and Guaranteed Modifiers in Path of Exile 2
summary: How Imprisoned Essences guarantee one modifier when crafting in Path of Exile 2: find and release essence monsters, the four quality tiers, the 0.5 one-essence rule, Perfect and corrupted essences, and how to finish a craft with other currency.
description: A practical guide to essence crafting in Path of Exile 2: use Imprisoned Essences to lock a guaranteed modifier onto an item, understand the single-essence rule, and combine essences with omens and other currency.
imageAlt: Imprisoned Essences used to guarantee a modifier when crafting in Path of Exile 2
prerequisites: Basic understanding of item rarity (Normal, Magic, Rare)
Access to the Reforging Bench and your currency stash
Familiarity with the item modifiers guide
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: What does an essence do?
body: An essence upgrades a target item while guaranteeing one specific modifier. Lesser, Normal and Greater essences turn a Magic item into a Rare with a forced modifier; Perfect essences work on Rare items and add a special exclusive modifier.

items.title: How many essence mods can one item have?
body: Since 0.5.0 a single item can carry only ONE essence-crafted modifier at a time. Older guides showing multiple stacked essences are legacy and no longer apply.

items.title: How do I get essences?
body: Find an Imprisoned Essence monster in the wild, interact with it three times to release it, kill the empowered monster, and it drops the essence it was holding.

sections.title: Version conflict: the one-essence rule
sections.intro: Patch 0.5.0 changed essence crafting. Flag any older information that contradicts the current rule.

conflicts.recommendation: Follow the one-essence rule: a single item holds only one essence-crafted modifier.
conflicts.detail: Since 0.5.0 each item can carry only one essence (crafted) modifier at a time, so spend that slot on the mod you cannot leave to chance.

conflicts.recommendation: Treat older multi-essence stacking guides as outdated.
conflicts.detail: Pre-0.5.0 guides that show two or more essence mods on one base no longer apply to the current patch.

sections.title: How to obtain Imprisoned Essences
paragraphs: Essence monsters are Imprisoned in the wild: a monster frozen inside an essence monolith. You will start seeing them in the campaign and they continue to appear through the endgame Atlas.

To trigger the encounter, interact with the imprisoned monster (click it) three times to shatter the prison and release it. The freed monster is empowered by the essence it holds and hits noticeably harder.
Kill the released monster and it drops the essence it was carrying. The in-game tooltip on the monster spells out exactly what it is holding.
bullets: Click / interact with the imprisoned monster three times to release it.
Do not fabricate extra keybinds beyond the standard interact action.
Kill the empowered monster to collect the dropped essence.

sections.title: The single-essence rule
paragraphs: The single most important rule in the current patch is the 0.5 one-essence limit: each piece of equipment can carry only one essence-crafted modifier at a time.
bullets: Do not try to apply a second essence to an item that already has an essence mod - it will not stack.
Spend your single essence slot on the one modifier you cannot leave to random rolls.
Finish the rest of the item with other currency and omens instead of more essences.
Before 0.5.0 players could stack several essences; that legacy behaviour is gone.

sections.title: Base and item level selection
paragraphs: Choose your base item deliberately before crafting. The base determines which modifier pools are available and how high the guaranteed modifier can roll.
Item level matters more than required level: a higher item level unlocks higher-tier rolls for both the guaranteed essence modifier and any later mods you add.
bullets: Pick a base whose implicit and item class fit the build you are making.
Favour higher item level bases so the guaranteed modifier can roll at its best tier.
Check the in-game item level display before committing an essence.

sections.title: Target preparation
paragraphs: Most essences apply to a Magic item and upgrade it to Rare with the guaranteed modifier. Perfect essences instead apply to an existing Rare item.
Prepare the target so the essence lands where you want it, within the single-essence limit.
bullets: For Magic-target essences: start from a Normal base, then use a Transmutation Orb and optionally an Augmentation Orb to set up a two-mod Magic item.
For Perfect essences: prepare a Rare item whose existing mods you are willing to risk losing.
Confirm the target rarity matches the essence you plan to use.

steps.label: Choose your base
body: Select the item base and rarity you want to craft on, keeping the build and item class in mind.

steps.label: Set the item level
body: Use a higher item level base so the guaranteed modifier can roll at its best tier. Check the base item level before applying.

steps.label: Prepare the target
body: Make the target a Magic item (or a Rare for Perfect) using Transmutation and Augmentation as needed, within the single-essence limit.

steps.label: Apply the essence
body: Use the essence on the prepared target to add the guaranteed modifier you selected.

steps.label: Follow-up currency
body: Finish the item with other currency or omens within the affix-slot rules; one essence mod does not block later exalts.

sections.title: Omen interactions with essence
paragraphs: After an essence guarantees its one modifier, you can still use other currency and omens to finish the item. The one essence mod does not block later exalts within the affix-slot rules.
bullets: Omens that steer affix type (for example Sinistral or Dextral Necromancy) can help place later mods on the side you want.
An essence consumes a crafted slot, so plan which mod is locked first and which mods are filled afterwards.
Boundaries: an essence guarantees one mod but does not change the total affix-slot limits of the item.

sections.title: Atlas and essence progression
paragraphs: Essences appear from the campaign through the endgame Atlas. In maps you can boost how many you find with Atlas passives and precursor tablet modifiers that affect essence monsters.
bullets: Imprisoned Essence monsters show up in map content as you push deeper into the Atlas.
Atlas passive nodes and precursor tablets can increase essence-monster frequency in their radius.
Farm the regions you are already running to gather essences efficiently.

cards.title: Why can't I add a 2nd essence mod?
body: Since 0.5.0 an item holds only one essence-crafted modifier at a time, so a second essence will not stack.

cards.title: What does Perfect remove?
body: A Perfect Essence removes an existing modifier and then adds a special exclusive modifier you usually cannot get another way.

cards.title: How do I get corrupted essences?
body: If you use a Vaal Orb on an imprisoned monster that holds a Greater Essence before releasing it, it may become a corrupted essence.

cards.title: Do essences work on any item?
body: Behaviour depends on target rarity (Magic or Rare) and item class; check the in-game essence tooltip for the allowed bases.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: If an essence craft is not behaving as expected, check these common failure points.
bullets: Essence did nothing: confirm the target rarity matches the essence (Magic for most, Rare for Perfect).
Second essence will not apply: the one-essence limit is already used on that item.
Wrong modifier: you cannot reroll an essence result like a random orb; the guaranteed mod is fixed by the essence used.
Unexpected removal: a Perfect Essence removes an existing mod - that is intended, not a bug.

items.question: Can I apply more than one essence to an item?
answer: No. Since 0.5.0 a single item can carry only one essence-crafted modifier at a time. Spend that slot on the mod you cannot leave to chance.

items.question: What does a Perfect Essence do?
answer: A Perfect Essence is used on a Rare item. It removes an existing modifier and then adds a special exclusive modifier that is usually not obtainable any other way.

items.question: How do I get Imprisoned Essences?
answer: Find an Imprisoned Essence monster in the wild, interact with it three times to release it, kill the empowered monster, and it drops the essence it was holding.

items.question: What are corrupted essences and how do I get them?
answer: Corrupted essences (Horror, Hysteria, Delirium, Insanity) are the valuable variants. If you use a Vaal Orb on an imprisoned monster that holds a Greater Essence before releasing it, it may become a corrupted essence. This is conditional, not guaranteed.

items.question: Do essences work on any item class?
answer: Essence behaviour depends on the target rarity (Magic or Rare) and the item class. The exact allowed bases are version-dependent, so check the in-game essence tooltip for the current list.

items.question: Can I still use other currency after an essence?
answer: Yes. An essence guarantees one modifier but does not block later Exalted Orbs or omens within the affix-slot rules. Use the essence first, then fill the remaining slots.
